recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. Do not reopen the retired hospitalization.dischargeDiagnosis element; any remaining concern about standard discharge-diagnosis codes in Encounter.diagnosis.use should proceed through FHIR-50827 or another final PA/terminology decision.
issue_request: FHIR-7304 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA DSTU1 issue requesting Encounter.hospitalization.dischargeDiagnosis cardinality change from 0..1 to 0..* because an encounter may have more than one discharge diagnosis; the accepted resolution also constrained the datatype to a Condition resource reference instead of Reference(Any).
initial_application: The request was historically applied in the Encounter spreadsheet era. Git commit 06c7ab8513 listed tracker 7304 in a ballot-reconciliation commit, and git commit 0983925cea explicitly listed tracker 7304 in the Encounter diagnosis admission/discharge family; together these changed the old dischargeDiagnosis representation to repeatable Condition-based diagnosis support and updated related Encounter diagnosis material.
additional_context: Later final PA decisions intentionally replaced the old DSTU1 element shape. FHIR-10544 removed Encounter.hospitalization.admittingDiagnosis and Encounter.hospitalization.dischargeDiagnosis in favor of Encounter.diagnosis. FHIR-16148 redesigned Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis for the current model, FHIR-19285 moved billing diagnosis ranking/type details to Account, and FHIR-20484 addressed repeatable diagnosis uses. FHIR-50827 is a current Triaged terminology follow-up about the Encounter diagnosis-use value set, but it is not final source-edit scope for this applied/published seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current authoritative source already supports multiple discharge diagnoses at the current specification level: Encounter.diagnosis is 0..*, Encounter.diagnosis.condition is 0..* CodeableReference constrained to Condition when referenced, and Encounter.diagnosis.use is 0..* CodeableConcept with text explicitly covering discharge roles.

related_jiras.note: Already represented on the combined branch; it audited the same Encounter discharge-diagnosis family and cited FHIR-7304 as the cardinality/type change.
